::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 29th [1860s]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Katherine Wykes-Sneyd
:::

My dear [Henrietta](people/person_538.qmd)

Many thanks to you both for your answers to the Scripture questions, - you see they are beginning to come into the [Monthly Paper](organizations/other_81.qmd) if you take it in

I hope [Glow Worm](people/person_534.qmd)'s cold is mending.  Her Gay Geese were quite new to the collections.  I have sent all the Goose answers, though I think [Gurgoyle](people/person_327.qmd)'s must stand as the best.  I think you will be delighted with the [Barnacle](organizations/other_89.qmd) it is a very grand one this time.[^1]

I am glad you have answered the Palm Sunday question.  I was afraid no one would.  Some unknown person sent me two nice answers for the two Christmas

&nbsp;

[passage missing where signature has been cut out]

&nbsp;

I shall help out one of your Palm Sunday answers with the other for the [M Paper](organizations/other_81.qmd).

---

[^1]: CMY refers to the essay contributions to the [Gosling Society](organizations/other_104.qmd) by Henrietta ('Irene'), her sister Charlotte ('Glow Worm') and Alice Coleridge ('Gurgoyle').
